printf '%s' "$INFERENCE_GATEWAY_API_KEY" > '/sandbox/codex-config/gateway-token.fullsend'.$$ &&

{ readonly FULLSEND_ENV_PYTHON="$(IFS=:; set -f; test -n "$FULLSEND_READLINK" || exit 1; for d in $FULLSEND_TRUSTED_PATH; do test -x "$d/python3" || continue; r="$(PATH="$FULLSEND_TRUSTED_PATH" "$FULLSEND_READLINK" -f "$d/python3" 2>/dev/null)" || continue; if ! test -O /; then p=$r; while :; do if test -w "$p" || test -O "$p"; then continue 2; fi; case $p in (/) break ;; esac; p=${p%/*}; p=${p:-/}; done; fi; printf '%s' "$r"; break; done)" &&
case "$FULLSEND_ENV_PYTHON" in /*) ;; *) false ;; esac || { echo 'fullsend: python3 not found in a PATH directory the agent cannot write' >&2; exit 127; }; } &&
FULLSEND_ENV_EXPORTS="$("$FULLSEND_ENV_PYTHON" -I -S -c 'import os, re, stat, sys
env_file, cap_line, envd_line, restore_line, iter_line, drop_arg = sys.argv[1:7]
RUNNER_PATH = "FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH"
drop = set(drop_arg.split())
drop_prefixes = tuple(d[:-1] for d in drop if d.endswith("*"))
envd_dir = os.path.dirname(envd_line.split()[3])
iter_file = iter_line.split()[3]
NAME = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*")
values = dict(os.environ)
exported = set(os.environ)
readonly = set()
order = []
failed = []
def warn(path, line, why):
	sys.stderr.write("fullsend: ignored %r line %d: %s\n" % (path, line, why))
def taken(name):
	return name not in drop and not (drop_prefixes and name.startswith(drop_prefixes)) and name not in readonly
def assign(path, line, name, value):
	if not taken(name):
		warn(path, line, "%s is not taken from .env" % name)
		return
	if "\0" in value:
		warn(path, line, "the value of %s contains a NUL byte" % name)
		return
	values[name] = value
	if name not in order:
		order.append(name)
def expand(s, i):
	if s.startswith("{", i):
		m = NAME.match(s, i + 1)
		if not m or not s.startswith("}", m.end()):
			raise ValueError("unsupported parameter expansion")
		return values.get(m.group(), ""), m.end() + 1
	m = NAME.match(s, i)
	if not m:
		raise ValueError("unsupported use of $")
	return values.get(m.group(), ""), m.end()
def value(s, i):
	out = []
	start = i
	while i < len(s):
		c = s[i]
		if c in " \t\n":
			break
		if c == "~" and (i == start or s[i - 1] == ":"):
			if i + 1 < len(s) and s[i + 1] not in "/: \t\n":
				raise ValueError("unsupported ~user")
			out.append(values.get("HOME", ""))
			i += 1
		elif c == "'\''":
			j = s.find("'\''", i + 1)
			if j < 0:
				raise ValueError("unterminated quote")
			out.append(s[i + 1:j])
			i = j + 1
		elif c == "\"":
			i += 1
			while True:
				if i >= len(s):
					raise ValueError("unterminated quote")
				c = s[i]
				if c == "\"":
					i += 1
					break
				if c == "\\" and i + 1 < len(s) and s[i + 1] in "$\"\\\x60\n":
					if s[i + 1] != "\n":
						out.append(s[i + 1])
					i += 2
				elif c == "$":
					v, i = expand(s, i + 1)
					out.append(v)
				elif c == "\x60":
					raise ValueError("command substitution")
				else:
					out.append(c)
					i += 1
		elif c == "$":
			v, i = expand(s, i + 1)
			out.append(v)
		elif c == "\\":
			if i + 1 >= len(s) or s[i + 1] == "\n":
				raise ValueError("line continuation")
			out.append(s[i + 1])
			i += 2
		elif c in ";&|<>()\x60":
			raise ValueError("not a plain assignment")
		else:
			out.append(c)
			i += 1
	return "".join(out), i
def end_of_statement(s, i):
	while i < len(s) and s[i] in " \t":
		i += 1
	if i < len(s) and s[i] == "#":
		i = s.find("\n", i)
		i = len(s) if i < 0 else i
	if i < len(s) and s[i] != "\n":
		raise ValueError("trailing text after the assignment")
	return i
def skip_statement(s, i, eol):
	stack = []
	while i < len(s):
		c = s[i]
		top = stack[-1] if stack else None
		if top == "'\''":
			if c == "'\''":
				stack.pop()
		elif c == "\\":
			i += 1
		elif c == "$" and s.startswith(("{", "("), i + 1):
			stack.append("}" if s[i + 1] == "{" else ")")
			i += 1
		elif top == "\"":
			if c == "\"":
				stack.pop()
		elif c in "'\''\"":
			stack.append(c)
		elif c == top:
			stack.pop()
		elif top == ")" and c == "(":
			stack.append(")")
		elif not stack:
			if c == "\n":
				return i
			if c == "#" and s[i - 1] in " \t;&|()":
				i = s.find("\n", i)
				return len(s) if i < 0 else i
		i += 1
	return eol if stack else len(s)
def statement(path, line, s, i, eol):
	j = i
	export = False
	if s.startswith("export", j) and j + 6 < len(s) and s[j + 6] in " \t":
		export = True
		j += 6
		while j < len(s) and s[j] in " \t":
			j += 1
	m = NAME.match(s, j)
	if not m:
		raise ValueError("not a NAME=value assignment")
	name = m.group()
	j = m.end()
	if j < len(s) and s[j] == "=":
		v, j = value(s, j + 1)
		j = end_of_statement(s, j)
		assign(path, line, name, v)
		if export and taken(name):
			exported.add(name)
		return j
	if not export:
		raise ValueError("not a NAME=value assignment")
	names = s[i:eol].split()[1:]
	if not all(NAME.fullmatch(n) for n in names):
		raise ValueError("not a NAME=value assignment")
	for n in names:
		if taken(n):
			exported.add(n)
			if n in values and n not in order:
				order.append(n)
	return eol
def is_file(p):
	try:
		return stat.S_ISREG(os.stat(p).st_mode)
	except PermissionError as e:
		failed.append((p, e))
	except OSError:
		pass
	return False
def read_included(p):
	e = read_file(p, False)
	if e is not None:
		failed.append((p, e))
def read_file(path, control):
	try:
		with open(path, encoding=sys.getfilesystemencoding(), errors="surrogateescape", newline="") as f:
			s = f.read()
	except OSError as e:
		return e
	i = 0
	while i < len(s):
		while i < len(s) and s[i] in " \t\n":
			i += 1
		if i >= len(s):
			break
		line = s.count("\n", 0, i) + 1
		eol = s.find("\n", i)
		eol = len(s) if eol < 0 else eol
		text = s[i:eol].rstrip(" \t")
		if text.startswith("#"):
			pass
		elif control and text == cap_line:
			if RUNNER_PATH not in readonly:
				assign(path, line, RUNNER_PATH, values.get("PATH", ""))
				readonly.add(RUNNER_PATH)
		elif control and text == envd_line:
			try:
				names = sorted(os.listdir(envd_dir))
			except (FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError):
				names = []
			except OSError as e:
				failed.append((envd_dir, e))
				names = []
			for n in names:
				p = os.path.join(envd_dir, n)
				if n.endswith(".env") and not n.startswith(".") and is_file(p):
					read_included(p)
		elif control and text == restore_line:
			now = values.get("PATH", "")
			assign(path, line, "PATH", values.get(RUNNER_PATH, "") + (":" + now if now else ""))
			exported.add("PATH")
		elif control and text == iter_line:
			if is_file(iter_file):
				read_included(iter_file)
		else:
			try:
				eol = statement(path, line, s, i, eol)
			except ValueError as e:
				warn(path, line, str(e))
				eol = skip_statement(s, i, eol)
		i = eol
	return None
err = read_file(env_file, True)
if err is not None:
	failed.insert(0, (env_file, err))
for path, e in failed:
	sys.stderr.write("fullsend: cannot read %r: %s\n" % (path, e.strerror))
if failed:
	sys.exit(1)
for n in order:
	if n in values and "\0" not in values[n]:
		sys.stdout.buffer.write(os.fsencode("%s%s='\''%s'\''\n" % ("export " if n in exported else "", n, values[n].replace("'\''", "'\''\\'\'''\''"))))
' '/sandbox/workspace/.env' 'if ( FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH= ) 2>/dev/null; then FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH="$PATH"; readonly FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH; fi' 'for f in /sandbox/workspace/.env.d/*.env; do [ -f "$f" ] &&
. "$f"; done' 'export PATH="$FULLSEND_RUNNER_PATH${PATH:+:$PATH}"' 'if [ -f /sandbox/workspace/.fullsend/iteration.env ]; then . /sandbox/workspace/.fullsend/iteration.env; fi' 'LD_PRELOAD LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_AUDIT PYTHON* BASH_ENV ENV IFS FULLSEND_ENV_PYTHON FULLSEND_ENV_EXPORTS FULLSEND_TRUSTED_PATH FULLSEND_READLINK FULLSEND_CODEX_BIN FULLSEND_CODEX_NODE FULLSEND_CODEX_PATH')" &&
